connections.line: What each tool really does today, and the AI that does your work.
connections.posting.opened: A browser window opened. Sign in there, then close it.
connections.steps.boxChecked: Post box and button last checked working on {day}. The first post checks the confirmation.
connections.steps.watch: A browser window opened. If Chausar asks there, click the item once.
connections.posting.limits.label: Your posting limits for {name}
connections.posting.limits.line: These limits are for this business; posts from every business on this computer count toward them. Chausar's own limits are the loosest it posts at, and you can only make them stricter. An empty box means Chausar's own.
connections.posting.limits.warmUpDays: Days of one post a day for a new channel
connections.posting.limits.duplicatePerc: Hold a post this percent like a recent one
connections.posting.limits.linkStreak: Warn at this many posts in a row linking one site
connections.posting.limits.saved: Saved. These limits apply to the next post.
connections.copyFailed: Couldn't copy the brief here. Copy it from Website build.
connections.blocked: Your browser blocked the new tab. Allow pop-ups for Chausar and try again.
connections.noOpen: This window can't open links yet.
connections.badLink: This link isn't one Chausar opens.
connections.sheet.label: Connection
connections.qualification.fixture-tested: Tested against a recording, not the live service.
connections.qualification.unqualified: Not yet checked against the live service.
connections.ai.title: Your AI
connections.ai.draft: No business is open yet, so this AI drafts your first plan.
connections.ai.spendNote: You pay the AI company directly. Chausar sets the cost aside before each call and refuses a call with no known price.
connections.ai.sendNothing: Your privacy setting sends nothing to AI, so every call is stopped.
connections.ai.replay: Answers come from a synthetic recording.
connections.ai.recommendedLine: One Anthropic key: Haiku for quick work, Sonnet for plans and drafts.
connections.ai.keyHint: Sent once to connect, then never shown again. If your browser offers to save it, choose Never.
connections.ai.model: Model id, as your account shows it
connections.ai.cap: Monthly limit in US dollars, optional
connections.ai.capHint: Calls stop when this month's spend reaches it.
connections.bank.label: Bank statement
connections.bank.title: Import a statement
connections.bank.line: A CSV file from your bank. Chausar reads it and never moves money.
connections.bank.accountHint: Your own name for it, like HDFC current.
connections.bankSheet.label: Bank account
connections.bankSheet.title: Bank account
connections.bankSheet.noAccounts: No accounts yet. Import a statement to add one.
connections.bankSheet.consentNone: No bank access given. Statements you import still work.
connections.bankSheet.addressHint: Only the number of new alerts goes there. Leave it empty to keep the address you set.
connections.bankSheet.noOpenInvoices: No open invoices to match this to.
connections.transcribe.title: Transcription on this computer
connections.transcribe.hint: Uses a whisper.cpp already on this computer. Chausar never installs it or downloads a model.
connections.transcribe.commandHint: The full path, for example C:\whisper.cpp\whisper-cli.exe
connections.transcribe.modelHint: The full path to the model you downloaded yourself, for example C:\whisper.cpp\models\ggml-base.bin
